tasks.corrected_reference_answer: BaseFormSet.initial_form_count returns management_form.cleaned_data[INITIAL_FORM_COUNT] when bound; otherwise it uses len(initial) or zero (django/forms/formsets.py:192-199). This count determines initial versus extra forms. It is not reconciled against server initial-list length, so a valid but different submitted count changes that classification. Missing or invalid management values are not silently accepted: full_clean records a missing_management_form error (410-421).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Reference is a polymorphic base interface for deferred DDL reference objects (django/db/backends/ddl_references.py:9-48). It supplies false predicates, no-op rename methods, and requires subclasses to implement SQL string conversion. This is interface-based polymorphism rather than evidence of a classic Template Method algorithm.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: run_validators invokes every validator, remaps an individual error message when its code exists in error_messages, extends a list with each error_list, then raises an aggregate ValidationError (django/forms/fields.py:186-198). ValidationError stores error_list during construction (django/core/exceptions.py:167-182); accessing it does not construct a new list. The code does not establish a bottleneck or that flattening later is faster. Any refactoring should be benchmarked and preserve missing-code behavior, message overrides, and error order.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: inhibit_post_migrate is an internal flush option. flush emits post_migrate only when SQL was executed and inhibition is false (django/core/management/commands/flush.py:86-91). TransactionTestCase enables inhibition for a restricted available_apps set or serialized_rollback with saved contents, avoiding recreation of data that will be restored (django/test/testcases.py:1251-1272). Populated migration history alone is not the condition.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Target.name uniqueness is checked when Target.validate_unique/full_clean is invoked; full_clean excludes failed fields before its unique checks (django/db/models/base.py:1594-1626). A ForeignKey to name requires an eligible unique target at model-check time (django/db/models/fields/related.py:638-674), and ForeignKey.validate checks that a matching target row exists (1127-1142). Referencing Target does not recursively call its uniqueness validation. save does not run full_clean and the related-save preparation can reject unsaved related objects (base.py:1202-1204).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Django passes a nested related select mask into get_default_columns and excludes fields outside that mask (django/db/models/sql/compiler.py:1026-1030,1241-1260). Non-deferred fields selected by select_related are loaded eagerly. Deferred fields remain absent from instance data and DeferredAttribute retrieves them on access, using a parent-chain value if available or refresh_from_db otherwise (django/db/models/query_utils.py:209-231). Thus lazy loading applies to deferred fields, not non-deferred parent attributes.
